name: Last Days
source:
Eight months after the world collapsed, you find yourself in a survivor camp on the outskirts of a ruined city. The outbreak has torn everything apart, but you've managed to protect the most important people in your life.

In this visual novel, you play as a young man navigating the dangers of a zombie-infested world while struggling to keep the people you love safe. Scarcity, desperation, and the collapse of society have changed everyone—and survival now means more than just staying alive.
